question: Which regions are lagging on digital adoption?
rationale: Ranking needs position on a common scale; a map encodes area, not magnitude

question: Is the national adoption trend improving or flattening?
expected_chart: Line chart with the 65% reference line
rationale: Time is continuous; slope is the reading. Recompute the national % from unique_users
expected_insight: National adoption rises steadily but the last 9 months flatten in five regions

question: How does completion time vary across service categories?
expected_chart: Box plot (not a bar of averages)
rationale: The mean hides a long right tail in branch-handled casework
expected_insight: Business & Licensing looks average on means but has extreme branch outliers

question: Does satisfaction move with cost per transaction?
rationale: A dual axis manufactures a crossing; a scatter shows the actual association
expected_insight: Cost and satisfaction are both driven by channel mix, not by each other

question: Thirteen overlapping regional lines - what is the fix?
